// CASE ts_canonical expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
}

// CASE ts_canonical_comment_in_worker expect=pass
export async function mapLimit2<T>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        // Each worker takes the next free index.
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
}

// CASE ts_canonical_min_width expect=pass
export async function mapLimit3<T>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: Math.min(width, items.length) }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
}

// CASE ts_canonical_arrow_const expect=pass
export const mapLimit4 = async <T,>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> => {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
};

// CASE ts_canonical_results expect=pass
export async function mapLimit5<T, R>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results;
}

// CASE ts_canonical_method expect=pass
export class Pool {
  async mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    let next = 0;
    await Promise.all(
      Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
        while (next < items.length) {
          const index = next++;
          await operation(items[index]);
        }
      }),
    );
  }
}

// CASE ts_impostor_extra_await expect=fire
export async function mapLimit6<T>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
        await audit(index);
      }
    }),
  );
}
async function audit(i: number) {}

// CASE ts_impostor_width_one expect=fire
export async function serialAll<T>(items: T[], operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: 1 }, async () => {
      while (next < items.length) {
        const index = next++;
        await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
}

// CASE ts_impostor_serial_join expect=fire
export async function mapLimit7<T>(
  items: T[],
  width: number,
  operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  const workers = Array.from({ length: width }, () => async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]);
    }
  });
  for (const worker of workers) {
    await worker();
  }
}

// CASE inorder_typed_alias expect=pass
type InOrderOptions = { reason: string };
export async function inOrder<T>(
  items: Iterable<T>,
  step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
  options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
